claims.title: Floating metal growth: shared electronic potential, ionic guards and paid regeneration

quoted_fields.interface: Uniform exposed patches share one electronic potential after connection. Symmetric mass-action currents, finite well-mixed stocks, fixed kinetic coefficients and independently controlled electrolyte potentials are introduced. Geometry, resistance, transport, capacitance and morphology are omitted.
quoted_fields.failure: Charge or dense-volume equivalence is not geometry. Zero erosion is not preserved dimensions, and field off is not chemical stop. Actual carrier chemistry, selective interfaces, ionic guards, physical isolation and erasure remain open.
